title: TensorBoard — What it is
description: TensorBoard (by the TensorFlow team at Google) is the classic training dashboard: point it at a log directory and it renders scalar curves (loss, accuracy), model graphs, histograms of weights, images, and projector views of embeddings. PyTorch writers (torch.utils.tensorboard.SummaryWriter) log add_scalar/add_image events; tensorboard --logdir runs serves it all on port 6006. Watching the curves is how trainers catch divergence before it wastes a day of GPU time. It is made by Google / TensorFlow team and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux (Python).
facts: SummaryWriter.add_scalar() logs loss/accuracy curves from PyTorch.
The Graphs tab renders the model's computation graph.
Histograms track weight and gradient distributions over steps.

tool = {

title: TensorBoard — Configuration essentials
description: TensorBoard is configured through a small, explicit surface: `tensorboard.logdir`, `tensorboard.port`, `tensorboard.reload_interval`. The demo below validates a sample configuration against the required keys, because most TensorBoard failures are configuration mistakes, and a validator catches them before they cost time.

demo_code:
required = ['tensorboard.logdir', 'tensorboard.port', 'tensorboard.reload_interval']
sample = {
    'tensorboard.logdir': 'runs',
    'tensorboard.port': 6006,
    'tensorboard.reload_interval': 30,
}
print('CONFIG VALIDATION')
ok = True
for k in required:
    good = k in sample and sample[k] not in (None, '')
    ok = ok and good
    print(f"  [{'PASS' if good else 'FAIL'}] {k} = {sample.get(k)!r}")
print('RESULT:', 'valid configuration' if ok else 'INVALID')

title: TensorBoard — Troubleshooting
description: When TensorBoard misbehaves, diagnose in order: re-check configuration, re-run the entry command `from torch.utils.tensorboard import SummaryWriter` (PyTorch writer import), then inspect the data formats for corruption. The demo below encodes this decision tree so the most common failures resolve to a concrete next step.
facts: TensorBoard is developed by the TensorFlow team at Google.
tensorboard --logdir=runs serves dashboards on port 6006.
SummaryWriter.add_scalar() logs loss/accuracy curves from PyTorch.
demo_code:
tree = [("won't start", 're-run entry command: from torch.utils.tensorboard import SummaryWriter (PyTorch writer import)'), ('wrong behavior', 'validate config keys: tensorboard.logdir, tensorboard.port, tensorboard.reload_interval'), ("can't find data", 'check Event files (tfevents) files exist in expected paths'), ('slow', 'reduce scope, then consult performance record (ladder 13)')]
symptom = 'wrong behavior'
print('DIAGNOSTIC DECISION TREE')
for s, fix in tree:
    mark = '>>>' if s == symptom else '   '
    print(f'{mark} if {s}: {fix}')
print('diagnosis for', repr(symptom), '->', [f for s, f in tree if s == symptom][0])
